en.title: Longest Password Segment
en.description: Find the longest contiguous substring that contains no digits and at least one uppercase English letter; output -1 if no such substring exists.
en.input: A single line containing a string of only a-z, A-Z, and 0-9, with 1≤length≤200.
en.output: Output the answer as described; for array answers, separate values with spaces.
en.explanation:
Digits split the string into letter-only segments; only segments that contain an uppercase letter are valid.

Correctness: no valid substring can cross a digit, so it lies entirely within one letter segment delimited by digits; it suffices to check whether each segment contains an uppercase letter.

Complexity: O(n) time, O(1) space.
hints: Digits split the string into letter-only segments; only segments that contain an uppercase letter are valid.
